gates.requiredScope: Verify the six accepted repository-relative input paths and normalized SHA-256 values and confirm the clarified requirements checklist has no incomplete item.
gates.rationale: Input drift invalidates every later disposition and implementation decision.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any accepted path/hash, spec, checklist, branch, scope, or run-state change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate exactly GAP-001 through GAP-157 once, exact 108 agent-actionable and 49 Human-only partition, status invariants, reciprocal CL mappings, evidence freshness, and zero untraced changed paths.
gates.rationale: One-to-one disposition and the unchanged Human-only boundary are the core acceptance contract.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any gap, CL mapping, disposition, evidence, changed path, or accepted baseline change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate Dockerfile pins, Home Baseline lock, paired script contracts, agent surface parity, documentation impact, JSON contracts, and diff hygiene without starting a container.
gates.rationale: Static failures must be resolved before expensive build/runtime checks.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any Dockerfile, Compose, script, test, contract, documentation, or guidance change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate the canonical static Compose configuration without relying on a running Podman socket; record optional native Podman Compose plausibility separately.
gates.rationale: This is the repository's canonical config-only check.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any Compose, env-example, mount, port, network, security option, or service change.

gates.requiredScope: Build the final local image from the final Dockerfile and dependency state, preserving failure exit codes and recording source and image identity.
gates.rationale: Dockerfile, source-integrity, toolchain, and agent claims require a practical final build.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any Dockerfile, build context, lock, downloaded artefact, package source, tool version, or base image change.

gates.requiredScope: Start the final container and verify non-root identity, capabilities, no-new-privileges, processes, effective mounts and modes, allowed/denied writes, localhost ports, egress facts, and separated agent state before ordered shutdown.
gates.rationale: Static configuration alone does not prove isolation effectiveness.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any runtime image, Compose, user, capability, mount, port, network, entrypoint, state-volume, or permission change.

gates.requiredScope: Verify identity/version and minimal functional behavior for six memory-safe toolchain families, two scripting foundations, four required agent CLIs, two additional agent surfaces, and supporting governance tools without provider calls.
gates.rationale: Installed-version declarations are not runtime evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any toolchain, agent, supporting tool, PATH, user, installation, or image identity change.

gates.requiredScope: Generate exactly one current CycloneDX SBOM for the final local image, run a pinned vulnerability scan, reconcile every relevant finding with VEX or an open blocker, and verify local provenance without registry distribution.
gates.rationale: Final-image component, vulnerability, exploitability, and build-origin claims need one causally ordered evidence set.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any source revision, image, component, scanner/database, SBOM, VEX, provenance, or distribution-scope change.

gates.requiredScope: Run the pinned pre-commit suite and repository agent-secret scanner without recording matching secret values.
gates.rationale: Changed configuration, evidence, scripts, and docs must contain zero real secrets or session content.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any changed/generated file, scanner rule, allowlist, credential pattern, or pre-commit configuration change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate the reader path, build/start/stop, mounts, ports, network, state, toolchains, smoke, supply-chain evidence, troubleshooting, VS Code flow, Human-only handoff, local links, and Documentation Impact decision.
gates.rationale: Security controls are incomplete when learner and operator instructions do not match final behavior.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any user flow, command, mount, port, network, tool, status, limitation, navigation, or documentation-impact change.

gates.requiredScope: Review every changed user-facing artefact for German-first/English-second CEFR-B2 content, four first-year training occupations, first-use terms, no assumed Spec Kit knowledge, text-first status/dependencies/decisions, and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
gates.rationale: The learner and accessibility baseline is binding for every user-facing change.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any learner-facing, operator-facing, CLI, Markdown, HTML, help, man-page, template, or status-output change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate a dated, non-sensitive moderated first-use result produced by Learning/A11Y Review: all four binding occupations represented, no prior Spec Kit experience, 30-minute limit, and at least 90 percent success for startup path, verification status, and next Human-only step.
gates.rationale: SC-009 is a human-observation outcome and cannot be proven by repository linting or fabricated by an agent.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any startup path, verification-status presentation, Human-only handoff, audience policy, test protocol, participant coverage, or learner-facing documentation change.

gates.requiredScope: Verify Bash/PowerShell behavior, dry-run/WhatIf, help/man page/Cmdlet contract, shared Python semantics, agent guidance surfaces, preset commands, templates, and constitution synchronization where shared rules changed.
gates.rationale: Cross-platform and agent surfaces must not silently drift.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any paired script, help, man page, Cmdlet, shared rule, agent surface, preset, template, or constitution change.

gates.requiredScope: Reconcile the paired Bash and PowerShell entry points, dry-run/WhatIf, man page, bilingual comment help, approved Verb-Noun Cmdlets, exit codes, and separate macOS, Linux, and Windows/WSL2 evidence records.
gates.rationale: The stable feature gate requires one explicit parity decision in addition to the three platform-specific results.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any paired interface, help/man page/Cmdlet, exit-code, platform result, or platform availability change.

gates.requiredScope: Run paired dry-run/static checks and available practical Podman/VS Code evidence on macOS.
gates.rationale: macOS is an affected host path and the current planning host.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any paired script, Podman machine, VS Code, path, mount, or host-command change.

gates.requiredScope: Run paired dry-run/static checks and available practical rootless Podman/VS Code evidence on Linux.
gates.rationale: Linux host behavior cannot be inferred solely from a Linux container on macOS.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any paired script, rootless Podman, VS Code, path, mount, or host-command change.

gates.requiredScope: Run PowerShell WhatIf/static checks and available Podman/VS Code evidence on Windows or WSL2; unavailable execution remains Open rather than Pass.
gates.rationale: Windows/WSL2 is a binding host path for paired PowerShell workflows.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any paired script, Podman Desktop/machine, VS Code, path, mount, or host-command change; retry when a Windows/WSL2 runner becomes available.

gates.requiredScope: Verify all and only the 49 baseline Human-only gap IDs remain Open, Not Assessed, and Unassessed without dated role evidence and that no formal, secret, registry, platform, or risk action is claimed.
gates.rationale: Prepared facts or templates cannot substitute for the named human role.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any Human-only mapping, role evidence, formal decision, residual-risk statement, or external-scope change.

gates.requiredScope: Verify whitespace hygiene and prove every changed path is mapped to at least one accepted gap and feature requirement or mandatory phase evidence; report zero unrelated refactors.
gates.rationale: The stable feature gate prevents unrelated or untraceable edits from entering delivery.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any worktree, staged set, delivery-set, gap mapping, requirement mapping, or mandatory phase-evidence change.

gates.requiredScope: After the orchestrator-created content commit, render Statistics Profile 2, validate it, and deliver only statistics changes in a separate post-content commit.
gates.rationale: Statistics must measure final content and remain separately reviewable under Profile 2.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any content-commit, phase-slot, methodology, statistics config, renderer, ledger, or post-content diff change.

gates.requiredScope: At the delivery boundary, the orchestrator revalidates current MergeAndSync authority, exact head, delivery set, all primary gates, no actionable review thread, valid schema-2 PreMerge evidence, no unrelated paths, and separate content, statistics, and causal PostMerge work. The already authorized Admin-Bypass may be used only through the provider merge operation when REVIEW_REQUIRED is the sole remaining policy blocker; it must never bypass a failed, pending, missing, stale, or contradictory technical/security gate or change repository rules.
gates.rationale: Model implementation tasks do not own commit, PR, merge, sync, or PostMerge authority. No additional authority request is required for this run's narrowly bounded provider-merge Admin-Bypass.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any authority, head, branch, delivery mode, gate, commit, PR, merge, default-branch, or PostMerge state change.

gates.requiredScope: OWASP ASVS implementation evidence for a first-party web, API, HTTP, authentication, or authorization service.
gates.rationale: The sandbox repository does not implement such a service; published learner ports are generic project mappings, not a first-party application endpoint.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A first-party web/API/HTTP/authentication/authorization service enters feature scope.

gates.requiredScope: Product AI-SBOM covering models, datasets, inference infrastructure, security properties, and KPIs.
gates.rationale: Agents and provider models are development tools; no model, dataset, or inference service is a released or operated sandbox runtime component.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: An AI model, dataset, inference service, embedding store, or AI runtime becomes part of the delivered or operated system.

gates.requiredScope: NIST SP 800-207 distributed Zero Trust architecture controls.
gates.rationale: The target is a local single-container learning sandbox without remote management, multi-device policy plane, or service architecture; provider access remains documented as a trust boundary.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Remote management, multi-device, distributed service, cloud identity, or service-to-service architecture enters scope.

gates.requiredScope: BSI C3A cloud-autonomy and BSI C5 cloud-compliance assurance evidence for a selected or operated cloud/managed service.
gates.rationale: Registry distribution, hosting, SaaS/PaaS/IaaS, managed-service selection, and provider deployment are excluded.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Cloud, hosting, managed-service, provider-deployment, or registry-distribution scope is authorized.

gates.requiredScope: Registry push, publication signature, external release provenance, or hosted deployment.
gates.rationale: The feature produces and evaluates a local image only; remote distribution is explicitly out of scope.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A later explicitly authorized feature adds image publication, signing, registry, or hosting delivery.
